title: Vegetable Soup
description: A large-batch tomato-based soup with mixed vegetables and acini di pepe pasta.

steps.instruction: Bring 6 quarts of water to boil, add sugar, salt, tomato sauce, telma instant beef broth, stir vigorously then add mixed vegetables and stir.
Bring about 4 quarts of water to boil, remove from heat, add acini depipi, cover and let stand for 15 to 20 minutes.
Cook until soup just starts to boil, remove from heat and then add acini depipi.
